tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 13 (testing & deployment) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 13) and spec.md first. This is the final phase: end-to-end tests, coverage, CI hardening, and static deployment. The app is a complete Vite + React 19 PWA (auth vault, accounts, transactions, budgets, import/export, scheduled txns, investments, reports, dashboard, cloud sync, onboarding). Existing: e2e/smoke.spec.ts + playwright.config.ts (Phase 0), .github/workflows/ci.yml (install → lint → typecheck → test → build → verify PWA), vite-plugin-pwa update prompt (Phase 12).

IMPORTANT — YOU CANNOT RUN THE E2E LOCALLY: this sandbox has no browser (Playwright can't launch; `pnpm run test:e2e` will fail here). Write the specs carefully against the REAL UI using accessible selectors, and rely on GitHub Actions CI (which installs browsers) to run them. Do NOT block your completion on running e2e; DO run typecheck, lint, and the unit suite.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: e2e/** (add core-flow specs), playwright.config.ts, vite.config.ts (add Vitest coverage config + set a production `base` for GitHub Pages), package.json (add @vitest/coverage-v8 + scripts), .github/workflows/ci.yml (add an e2e job + coverage, and BUMP the deprecated actions), .github/workflows/deploy.yml (create), public/404.html (SPA fallback), docs/DEPLOYMENT.md (create), and MINIMAL additive `data-testid` attributes on existing pages/components ONLY where an e2e needs a stable selector (NO logic changes). Do NOT change any application logic (crypto/auth/db/stores/reports/etc.), the .md plan files (spec.md, plan-reborn.md, prompt_plan.md, todo.md), or .ringer/. Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE:
1. e2e/ — Playwright specs for the CORE FLOW using accessible selectors (getByRole/getByText/getByLabel): first-run SETUP (create a vault — basic mode: email + password), then CREATE AN ACCOUNT, ADD A TRANSACTION, and assert it appears (in the transactions list and/or reflected on the dashboard/reports). A second spec may cover: load sample data from Settings → reports render. Add data-testid attributes where accessible selectors are insufficient. playwright.config.ts must have a webServer that builds+previews (or runs) the app so CI can drive it; configure baseURL and a sensible timeout.
2. Coverage — add @vitest/coverage-v8; configure Vitest coverage in vite.config.ts (provider 'v8', text + html + lcov reporters) with reasonable thresholds (e.g. lines/functions/statements >= 60, branches >= 50 — pick values the current suite actually meets; do NOT set thresholds the suite fails). Add scripts: `test:coverage` (vitest run --coverage) and `test:e2e` (playwright test).
3. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) — BUMP actions/checkout@v4 → @v5, actions/setup-node@v4 → @v5, actions/upload-artifact@v4 → @v5 (silences the Node-20 deprecation). Run the unit tests with coverage. Add a SEPARATE e2e job that: checks out, sets up Node + corepack pnpm, installs deps, runs `pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps`, then runs `pnpm run test:e2e`, uploading the Playwright report artifact on failure.
3. Deploy (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) — on push to main, build the app and deploy dist/ to GitHub Pages (actions/configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact, deploy-pages; permissions pages: write, id-token: write). For a project Pages site the app is served under /MonetaFoxReborn/, so set vite `base` accordingly for the production build (e.g. base: '/MonetaFoxReborn/' or from an env var) so assets + the PWA resolve. Provide an SPA fallback: public/404.html that boots the same app (copy of index.html behavior) so client-side routes work on refresh.
4. docs/DEPLOYMENT.md — document: how to build, the GitHub Pages deploy flow, the base-path note, enabling Pages in repo settings, and how the PWA update prompt works (users get 'new version — Reload').

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test` (unit suite — must stay green), `corepack pnpm run lint`. Do NOT run test:e2e locally (no browser). `pnpm run build` is verified by CI.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the e2e flow + selectors used, the coverage thresholds chosen (and the measured coverage), the CI e2e job, the deploy workflow + base-path handling, and any follow-up (esp. anything only verifiable in CI).

HARD RULES: do NOT change application logic (only add data-testid where needed); do NOT set coverage thresholds the suite fails; bump the deprecated actions; keep the unit suite green and deterministic; write e2e against the real UI with accessible selectors; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: Structure verified: e2e specs cover the core flow (setup/unlock -> account -> transaction) with a Playwright webServer; Vitest coverage is configured with thresholds the suite meets (+ @vitest/coverage-v8 and scripts); CI runs the e2e job AND bumps the deprecated @v4 actions; a deploy workflow (GitHub Pages), an SPA fallback, and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md exist. The Phase 1/3a contract tests still pass; typecheck + lint are green. The e2e RUN + coverage + production build are gated by CI (browsers, no 60s cap). Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
